angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 18,018,630 km at 1884.00 pc = 0.13 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Groenewegen (2013), A&A 550, A70, table10, BE Mon: Baade-Wesselink distance (pc) 1884 +/- 233.4 (Monte-Carlo) (https://arxiv.org/abs/1212.5478): 1884 +/- 233.4 pc; Gaia DR3 parallax 0.4700 +/- 0.0174 mas (same row, RUWE 1.17), 27.0 standard errors, is not used
radiusSource: Radius 25.9 +/- 3.2 solar radii from Groenewegen (2013), A&A 550, A70, table10, BE Mon: Baade-Wesselink mean radius (solar radii) 25.9 +/- 3.2 (Monte-Carlo) (https://arxiv.org/abs/1212.5478): 18,018,630 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. No mass is measured, so GM is 0, the records' unpublished value. Temperature 6000 +/- 316 K from Groenewegen (2020), A&A 635, A33, VizieR J/A+A/635/A33/table1, recno 401, Name='BE Mon', columns Teff, e_Teff (K): Teff 6000 +/- 316 K from a fit to the spectral energy distribution at mean light (not spectroscopic) (https://arxiv.org/abs/2002.02186). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Groenewegen (2020), A&A 635, A33, VizieR J/A+A/635/A33/table1, recno 401, Name='BE Mon', columns Teff, e_Teff (K): Teff 6000 +/- 316 K from a fit to the spectral energy distribution at mean light (not spectroscopic) (https://arxiv.org/abs/2002.02186)
surfaceGravitySource: log g 1.7 from 2023A&A...678A.195D, the median of its 2 spectra; the 6 published values span log g 1.5 to 2.49, across which the limb law changes by at most 0.4% of the centre brightness (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023A%26A...678A.195D)
spectralTypeSource: SIMBAD, V* BE Mon: spectral type G5
objectTypeSource: SIMBAD, V* BE Mon: main object type cC*, Classical Cepheid Variable

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius, colored from a blackbody at the star's published temperature (photometry/stellar-color.json); no image of the photosphere exists.
